concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-wells-flat-change-your-bank-account]] - Braintree-hosted Wells Flat route for permission-gated disbursement-account viewing and a documented Control Panel change request with qualifying bank documents and a US-based business-checking condition; not Wells IC, independent current bank policy, proof of eligibility or completed change, or evidence for the presence or absence of an API route
warnings: Keep the route scoped to the captured Wells Flat article; do not transfer its account or document conditions to Wells IC or another account or pricing configuration.
The documented Control Panel procedure neither proves nor disproves that an API route exists, and the snapshot is not independent current bank policy or proof that a requested change completed.
